earnest: a little room, when it opens
another turn in the waiting room
a pause with a familiar shape
another full sign at the door
back on this side of the gate
the door is busy once more
another little wait to sit with
the queue still has our place
the pause has come back around
a return to the waiting corner
this gate is a frequent stop
